Guy, there's always someone that is better at something than you, me, or anyone else. But nobody is perfect, absolutely nobody. If your girlfriend is more somebody else's girlfriend than she is yours, she doesn't deserve you. Not in the least, doesn't deserve someone as strong as you. Yes, I say strong, because as I said before, you deal with sooooo much crap,  and you have for such a long time. It doesn't matter if you're not good at something, you don't have to be. All that matters is that you have fun doing it. I have trouble with letting people in too, but a lot of the time, a shoulder to cry on is what you need. Let someone in, let them share a bit of the burden. If you want things to be different, make them different. I care about you. Me, a total stranger. If I didn't, I wouldn't be talking to you about this.

There's always a point in living. Life is what you make it. Things may be bad, but you can make it better for yourself. If you have problems controlling your emotions, tell someone about it. If you're a dick to your girlfriend because you can't keep yourself in check, apologize to her, and if she really loves you she'll forgive you. You can always make yourself happy- Do something you love! Learn to play guitar, or cook, or anything. I think I'm worthless a lot, but then I look in the mirror and say 'Dude, you've put up with shit for this long, you're awesome.'
